test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven judges, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row of seven seats on the jury panel. C is sitting to the immediate left of A. D is sitting to the immediate right of B and to the immediate left of F. E is sitting on the last seat from the left of the row. C is sitting to right of G and to left of D.

Who is sitting on the fifth position from the left?
solution:
**Judges: **A, B, C, D, E, F, and G

Step 1) They are sitting in a row of seven seats on the jury panel.

Step 2) E is sitting on the last seat from the left of the row. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8188a63f5dd787adccb09fac7f5d67fbaa32604a35d8daa3721d9ce551dda9a.png] 

Step 3) D is sitting to the immediate right of B and to the immediate left of F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd91b9951ee1a02f5a789b441df3e24de7a5ef8d619dbaeaf6399e7fcc345072.png] 

Step 4) C is sitting to the immediate left of A and is sitting to the right of G and to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00a9349b22de0325a2f7398d090503c814161afd62b4d8b3043ff51eca562204.png] 

**D is sitting on the fifth position from the left**.

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
